newsitem.title: FINLAND: Valmet says 1997 profit outlook good.
newsitem.headline: Valmet says 1997 profit outlook good.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said on Wednesday the group's profitability and profit development prospects were good.
"The 1997 outlook for group profitability and profit development remains good," Valmet said in a statement with its 1996 results.

Referring to its key clients, paper and board mills, Valmet said: "The prevaling market situation has decreased willingness of customers to invest and has postponed the implementation of planned projects. Tight competition and uncertainty is expected to continue into the first half of 1997."
Valmet said it was taking steps to mantain steady profitability.

"To reduce its sensitivity to business cycles, Valmet is continuing a policy of extending its international marketing and service network. Greater efforts are being made to sell machine rebuilds and service in addition to new machines," it said.
"The aim is to maintain satisfactory profitability through every stage of the business cycle," Valmet added.
Last year, the group's profit after financial items rose 66 percent to 1.06 billion markka. Net sales rose to 11.8 billion markka from 8.6 billion.
